The issuer exhibits solid profitability with an 18% operating margin and $537M in operating income, backed by a substantial asset base of $12.7B and positive equity of $4.1B. However, its financial profile is constrained by a relatively high leverage ratio (total liabilities-to-equity of approximately 2.1x) and a weak short-term liquidity position, as evidenced by a current ratio of 0.83 ($1,107M in current assets against $1,333M in current liabilities). These balanced credit factors—healthy profitability offset by elevated leverage and tight liquidity—are characteristic of an investment-grade issuer at the lower end of the spectrum.

DECISION: BBB-
